review:
A caveman discovers fire, on a 5x4 paylines grid with dinosaurs. Burning symbols set their reel alight above where they land: burnt low symbols turn into another special symbol, and burnt high symbols become Burnt Multipliers that add to every win they're in.

Each premium has its own burnt multiplier, so a burning reel full of high symbols is the dream. In the top bonus, the Wildfire Bar climbs through levels as the round goes on. Rated high, 10,000x max in every mode, top RTP 96.19%.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Casinos can run versions as low as 86.22% RTP
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
